tagline: Internet ke error messages, aur ping ke peeche ka tool.
description: ICMP woh tareeka hai jisse routers aur hosts IP packets ki problems report karte hain: “too many hops”, “us host tak nahi pahunch sakte”, “packet too big”. Isme ek simple echo request aur reply bhi hota hai, jise ping use karta hai yeh test karne ke liye ki host jawab deta hai ya nahi aur kitna time lagta hai. Traceroute in error messages par bana hai aur path ka map banata hai.
facts: Network (Layer 3), IP ke andar chalta hai

ping.name: ping example.com
ping.summary: Teen echo requests aur teen replies naapte hain ki server jawab deta hai ya nahi aur kitni tez.

steps.title: Echo request
steps.desc: Type 8, id 0x1a2b, seq 1, 56 bytes of data
steps.detail: ping ek ICMP Echo Request bhejta hai: type 8, code 0, ek identifier jo is ping run ko mark karta hai, aur sequence number 1. 56 data bytes ki shuruaat send time se hoti hai, jo ping reply se wapas padhkar round trip naapta hai.

steps.title: Echo reply
steps.desc: Type 0, same id, same seq, same data
steps.detail: Server ka operating system khud jawab deta hai; koi program chalna zaroori nahi. Woh message ko type 0 mein badalta hai, addresses swap karta hai aur bilkul wahi identifier, sequence number aur data wapas bhejta hai. ping identifier match karke time print karta hai.

quiz.q: ping ko kaise pata chalta hai ki yeh reply uski apni request ka hai?
quiz.why: Reply identifier aur sequence number copy karta hai. Identifier is ping run ko pehchanta hai; sequence number batata hai ki yeh kaunsi request ka jawab hai.

steps.title: Har second mein ek
steps.detail: ping har second ek request bhejta rehta hai, aur sequence number har baar badhta hai. Replies mein koi number missing ho to matlab woh request ya uska reply kho gaya. Round-trip times thoda upar-neeche hote hain kyunki router queues badalti rehti hain.

steps.title: Summary
steps.detail: Ctrl+C dabane par ping batata hai kitne replies wapas aaye aur minimum, average aur maximum round-trip time. Isse do sawalon ka jawab ek saath mil jata hai: host reachable hai ya nahi, aur time ke hisaab se kitna door hai.

quiz.q: ping 3 sent, 2 received dikhata hai. Tum kya keh sakte ho?
options: Ek request ya uska reply kho gaya
Server ne ek ping refuse kiya
quiz.why: ICMP dobara nahi bheja jata, isliye reply missing hona bas yeh batata hai ki do packets mein se ek raste mein kho gaya. Down server ek bhi jawab nahi deta.

outro.title: Reachable, 24 ms door
outro.text: ping ne sirf do ICMP types use kiye: echo request aur echo reply. Data ka identifier, sequence number aur timestamp loss dhoondhne aur round trip naapne ke liye kaafi hain.

traceroute.name: traceroute: path ka map banao
traceroute.summary: TTL 1, 2, 3 ke probes har router ko Time Exceeded bhejkar apna address batane par majboor karte hain.

steps.title: TTL 1
steps.desc: Pehle router par mar jata hai
steps.detail: traceroute TTL 1 ka probe bhejta hai. Home router use 0 kar deta hai, drop karna padta hai, aur apne address se ICMP Time Exceeded wapas bhejta hai. Ab laptop ko hop 1 pata chal gaya. Asli traceroute har hop ke liye teen probes bhejta hai; yahan ek dikhaya gaya hai.

quiz.q: Time Exceeded kaunse address se aata hai?
quiz.why: Jis router par TTL zero hota hai woh error apne address se bhejta hai. Wahi address traceroute us hop ke liye print karta hai.

steps.title: TTL 2
steps.detail: Agla probe TTL 2 ka hai. Home router use 1 karke forward karta hai; ISP router use 0 karta hai aur report karta hai. Reply ghar wapas aate hue ek router cross karta hai, isliye TTL 63 ke saath pahunchta hai.

steps.title: TTL 3
steps.desc: Core router apna address batata hai
steps.detail: TTL 3 ke saath probe core router tak pahunchta hai aur wahan khatam ho jata hai. Har hop ka time us router tak ka poora round trip hota hai, isliye probes jaise-jaise aage jate hain numbers badhte hain.

quiz.q: TTL 4 wale probe ko kya wapas milega?
options: Kuch nahi, TTL 4 bahut zyada hai
quiz.why: Server 4 hops door hai, isliye TTL 4 bas kaafi hai. Probe server tak pahunchta hai, jo echo request ka normal jawab deta hai, aur traceroute ruk jata hai.

steps.title: TTL 4 server tak pahunchta hai
steps.desc: Echo reply trace khatam karta hai
steps.detail: Chautha probe teeno routers se bach jata hai aur server tak pahunchta hai, jo normal echo reply se jawab deta hai. traceroute destination ka jawab dekhta hai aur hops ki poori list print karta hai.

outro.title: Path, hop by hop
outro.text: traceroute ne ek safety feature ko map bana diya. TTL ko ek-ek karke badhakar usne path ke har router se apne address se Time Exceeded message bhijwaya. Windows tracert bhi echo requests ke saath isi tarah kaam karta hai; Linux traceroute default mein UDP probes use karta hai.

unreachable.name: Reply nahi: unreachable host aur firewall
unreachable.summary: Ek ping ko Destination Host Unreachable milta hai; doosre ko kuch nahi milta kyunki firewall use drop kar deta hai.

steps.title: Band host ko ping karo
steps.desc: Aakhri router use dhoondh nahi paata
steps.detail: Laptop 203.0.113.99 ko ping karta hai, jo ek purana server hai aur band kar diya gaya hai. Request core router tak pahunchti hai, jo us network se directly connected hai. Woh ARP se host ka MAC address poochta hai, lekin koi jawab nahi deta.

steps.title: Host unreachable
steps.detail: Lagbhag teen second ki khamoshi ke baad core router haar maan leta hai aur ping drop kar deta hai. Woh ping ki shuruaat quote karte hue ICMP Destination Unreachable, code 1 (host unreachable) bhejta hai. ping print karta hai “From 203.0.113.1 icmp_seq=1 Destination Host Unreachable”.

quiz.q: Destination Unreachable message kaun bhejta hai?
options: Woh router jo deliver nahi kar paya
quiz.why: Host band hai aur kuch keh nahi sakta. Aakhri router, jo ARP se use dhoondh nahi paya, problem report karta hai.

steps.title: Firewall wale server ko ping karo
steps.detail: Ab laptop web server ko ping karta hai. Uska firewall ICMP echo requests ko bina kuch kahe drop karne ke liye set hai. Na reply aata hai na error, isliye ping bas wait karta hai aur timeout report karta hai. Phir bhi port 443 par website theek chalti hai.

quiz.q: Server ko ping timeout ho raha hai, lekin website load hoti hai. Kyun?
options: Firewall pings drop karta hai lekin HTTPS allow karta hai
quiz.why: Kai servers aur firewalls ping block kar dete hain. Timeout ka matlab bas itna hai ki echo reply wapas nahi aaya; yeh prove nahi karta ki host down hai.

outro.title: Error, ya bas khamoshi
outro.text: Jab router packet deliver nahi kar pata to aam taur par ICMP Destination Unreachable se bata deta hai. Pings drop karne wala firewall kuch bhi nahi kehta. Isliye error message batata hai ki problem kahan hai, jabki khamoshi bas itna batati hai ki path par kuch jawab nahi de raha.
facts: Host down hone ka saboot nahi
